en: Black-and-white night photograph of a round, modernist tramway waiting house with illuminated signage on its roof reading "BRAU PUNTIGAM" and a small clock above the entrance. The building is lit from below the eaves and through its windows and doors, reflecting on the wet cobblestone square. Benches curve around the structure. Text at the bottom right identifies the scene as a night view of the tramway waiting house at Jakominiplatz in Graz.
